verdicts.reproduction: Read develop-orchestrator.md:1360 ('Runs ONLY after gate.passed is written') and :1515-1531 (4c). debate-protocol.md:331-338: unresolved.json entries carry topic/phase/from_agent/domain/auto_resolved_with/confidence/reason/needs_review and no decision_id. grep 'provisional: auto-resolved' finds only the orchestrator line; no hook or test checks that 4c ran.

Rated MEDIUM because the consequence stays in the ledger (duplicate or missing provisional entries, so a later session may re-decide a default); it does not pass broken work through the gate.

verdicts.reproduction: make_debate cache, then sed '- status: active' -> '- status: reversed' in docs/DECISIONS.md. debate-status: resolved, gate []. --check exit=0. Full verify-gate.sh exit=0 PASS. promoted() (debate-status.py:306-311) matches only the '- link:' line.

Narrower consequence than the wording implies: a block only becomes 'reversed' through remember.sh --reverses, which writes a newer active entry at the same time, so the ledger stays coherent; what is lost is that the topic is never flagged for re-run or review. Same root cause as TEST-06 (promoted() binds by link path and ignores status), whose fix 'exactly one ACTIVE block' covers this.

verdicts.reproduction: grep -n 'debate-status|blocking|NEEDS_DECISION' over plan/discuss/design/init.md: only the shared header line (plan.md:28 etc.), no closing sweep. child-returns.md:81 'right after the wave that raised it'. develop-orchestrator.md: debate-status appears only at :230 (hook staging) and :1220-1221 (Wave 6 0c); nothing before Wave 2. Wave 5v (:1116-1145) re-runs only when a sidecar's code_sha differs from the code commit, and lists test_runner, mobile_e2e_orchestrator, acceptance_test_agent, spec_test_reconciler, security_reviewer; no spec_impl_reconciler. A spec edit by a relaunched /plan agent changes no code sha, so STALE is empty and nothing re-runs.
verdicts.note: Holds end to end. The operating contract in every agent (e.g. moderator:252) tells it to file blocking:false and continue; /plan has no step that dispatches such a request; /develop first sees it at Wave 6 0c; and the relaunch path re-verifies on code evidence only, so a spec that now records the winner and code that implements the loser both pass. HIGH: a missing step the pipeline depends on, with the gate certifying the result; not CRITICAL because it needs a non-blocking request from a planning agent whose default then loses.

verdicts.reproduction: make_debate lib (HIGH), rm lib.argument-B.md, confidence MEDIUM: status invalid 'missing lib.argument-B.md'. Then a two-line partial lib.argument-B.md: status resolved (gate only wants the second opinion). make_debate lib --impact MEDIUM: no argument files needed, resolved. rm lib.research-B.md with RESOLVED MEDIUM: invalid; the same with status INCOMPLETE / LOW: resolved (debate-status.py:269 skips the file check for INCOMPLETE).
verdicts.note: The contradiction is real but smaller than claimed: it exists only for HIGH impact when an advocate's argument file is absent or empty. An advocate that returned PARTIAL after writing something passes the checker; MEDIUM impact never needs arguments; and for a missing research brief the arbitrator's own rule (:101-102 'an option has no research at all' -> INCOMPLETE) already agrees with the checker. MEDIUM: fails in one situation, and the arbitrator can resolve it by writing INCOMPLETE.
